															Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering (GATE 2027)

															Indian Institute of Technology, IIT Madras
															
														
														
															WWW.RESULTBHARAT.COM
														
														
															
															Application Fee

															
																Phase I
																General/ OBC/ EWS Candidates : Rs. 2000/-
																SC/ ST/ PH Candidates : Rs. 1000/-
																All Female Candidates : Rs. 1000/-
																Phase II (Extended Period)
																General/ OBC/ EWS Candidates : Rs. 2500/-
																SC/ ST/ PH Candidates : Rs. 1500/-
																All Female Candidates : Rs. 1500/-

															Important Dates

															
																Online Apply Start On : 27 August 2026
																Registration Last Date :  27 September 2026
													
																Last Date for Registration/ Application Process (With Late Fee) : 05 October 2026
																Application Rectification Date: 14-21 October 2026
																Exam City Available : 04 January 2027
																Admit Card Available : Notify Later
																Exam Date : 06, 07, 13, 14, 20 & 21 February 2027
																Result Declared : 19 March 2027

																Passed/ Appearing BE/ B.Tech/ B.Pharma/ B.Arch/ B.Sc. Research/ M.Sc./ MA/ MCA/ ME/ M.Tech/ Dual Degree/ Integrated Course.
																For More Eligibility Details.Read the Notification

																Descent Quality Latest Passport Size Color Photo with White Background.
																Face Should be Occupy at least 75% of Photo.

																Draw Rectangular Box 3 CM. X 5 CM. on A4 Size, Mark Your Left Thumb Impression within Draw box.

        📋 How to Apply IIT GATE 2027 Admission Online Form

        
            Visit the official GATE 2027 website gate2027.iitm.ac.in and go to GOAPS portal.
            Register as a New User by entering your name, valid email ID, mobile number and create a password.
            Login with Enrollment ID and Password to fill the online application form with personal, academic details and choose exam papers & cities.
            Upload scanned documents (photo, signature, ID proof, category certificate if applicable) in prescribed format.
            Pay the application fee online and submit the form. Download and print the confirmation page for future reference.
        

        Note: Check all details carefully before final submission. Contact helpline for any issues.
